title: Scacco alla regina
writer: Tullio Pinelli, Brunello Rondi, Renato Ghiotto
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Haydée Politoff, Romolo Valli
plot: 26 year old Silvia has it all, but is still discontent, and daydreams about BDSM sex. When her husband is away on a business trip, she goes to a castle outside Rome to work as a secretary. Here she is turned into a slave.
